scope.boundary_rule: Recovered from stale catch-up artifacts; original source windows/clocks remain in migration_provenance.

migration_provenance.normalization_note: Normalized start backward by 130 seconds to make the modern sequence contiguous. Original stale start remains preserved.

new_events.summary: CBS reported U.S. officials said Iranian forces brought down at least two American MQ-1 unmanned aircraft in recent days. Location and variant were undisclosed. The reported type is MQ-1, not MQ-9, and cannot be mapped automatically to either Qeshm claim.

Italy's defence minister called for more naval assets to protect Red Sea navigation and said Italy was preparing an independent naval mission. This is deployment intent, not evidence that additional ships were already deployed.

AP reported Iran's largest government-organized rally since the war began, with more than 300,000 participants reported in Tehran. Iranian officials separately claimed more than 600,000 civilian military-training registrations and projected more than one million; registration totals remain official claims.

existing_event_updates.summary: UKMTO reporting described a tanker incident involving an unknown projectile while IRGC identified Trend. This strengthens existence of a maritime attack/incident but does not establish weapon, U.S. direction or broad Hormuz-control claims.
Reuters reported an IOM figure of at least 112,000 internally displaced plus nearly 3,000 who fled to Djibouti. This refines the IOM series without merging it with OCHA/aid-agency estimates.

AP reported a U.S. military estimate of $43.6 billion in war cost as of Sep.3, including $28.1 billion in weapons expenditures, with continuing interceptor-stock concerns. The Sep.3 cost date remains distinct from Sep.18 publication.
AP reported U.S. visas approved for President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi for UNGA with travel/purchasing restrictions. Access remains distinct from negotiations.

claims_and_corrections.claim: More than 600,000 civilians had registered for military training and participation would exceed one million.
claims_and_corrections.summary: Separate observable rally attendance reporting from official training-registration/projection claims.

claims_and_corrections.claim: IRGC described Qeshm losses as the 52nd/53rd MQ-9, while separate U.S.-official-source reporting described at least two recent U.S. losses as MQ-1.
claims_and_corrections.summary: Type-specific U.S. reporting is material context but does not identify the MQ-1 losses with either Qeshm occurrence.

unresolved_questions: Locations/variants of the two U.S.-reported MQ-1 losses and whether either relates to Qeshm
Current Yemen displacement denominator by source/timebox
Whether Italy's naval mission is deployed and with what mandate
Independent audit of Iranian military-training registrations

material_results: U.S.-source UAS type evidence, tanker corroboration, Yemen denominator, Italy intent, war-cost and Iranian mobilization reporting recovered.
checked_no_material_new_event_in_window: No direct evidence mapped MQ-1 losses to Qeshm MQ-9 claims.
limitations: U.S. officials in CBS report were unnamed; CENTCOM declined comment.
Forward deployment intent is not deployed force posture.
